preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the binary string is between 2 and 200,000, and it is even.
The binary string consists of only 0s and 1s.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total length of all binary strings across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if a solution exists, or 'NO' if it does not.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'YES', then two balanced bracket sequences a and b are provided
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then two balanced bracket sequences of the same length as the input binary string are provided, where a[i] and b[i] are equal if s[i] is 1, and different if s[i] is 0.
